.²1 An efficient cause.
.²2 A creator; {#jaya deva BuvanaBAvana#} <ls>Māl. 9. 4</ls>.
.²3 An epithet of Śiva.
.²4 Of Viṣṇu.

.²1 Creating, manifesting; {#BAvanaM brahmaRaH sTAnam#} <ls>Bhāg. 3. 26. 46</ls>.
.²2 Promoting any oneʼs interests.
.²3 Conception, imagination, fancy, thought, idea; {#maDuripurahamiti BAvanaSIlA#}
 <ls>Gīt. 6</ls>; or {#BAvanayA tvayi lInA#} <ls n="Gīt.">4</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3. 162</ls>.

 <ls>Bg. 2. 66</ls>; {#yAdfSI BAvanA yasya sidDirBavati tAdfSI#} <ls>Pt. 5. 105</ls>.
.²5 Meditation, contemplation, abstract meditation.
.²6 A supposition, hypothesis.
.²7 Observing, investigating.
.²8 Settling, determining;

 {#viBAgaBAvanA jYeyA#} <ls>Y. 2. 149</ls>.
.²9 Remembering, recollection.
.²10 Direct knowledge, perception or cognition.
.²11 The cause of memory which arises from direct perception (in logic);
 see {#BAvanA#} and {#smfti#} in <ls>T. S.</ls>; {#BAvanAKyastu saMskAro jIvavfttiratIndriyaH#} <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls>
.²12 Proof, demonstration, argument.
.²13 Steeping, infusion, saturating a dry powder with fluid; {#draveRa#}
 {#yAvanmAnena cUrRaM sarvaM plutaM Bavet . BAvanAyAH pramARastu cUrRe proktaM#}
 {#BizagvarEH#} <ls>Bhāva P.</ls>

.²15 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) Finding by combination or composition.
.²16 Nature, essence (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>).
.²17 Reason, cause; {#parAvareSaM prakftimasyotpattyantaBAvanam#} <ls>Bhāg. 3. 32. 7</ls>.
